name: chat-overlay
description: Transparent always-on-top chat overlay for GoodGame.ru and Twitch

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e: node test/e2e/run.mjs && node test/e2e/run.mjs --scenario=drop && node test/e2e/run.mjs --scenario=degraded && node test/e2e/run.mjs --scenario=staged && node test/e2e/run.mjs --scenario=trials && node test/e2e/run.mjs --scenario=crash
